facts.what: 睡梦异象中，Sarah 的「海族」家人在爆炸中几乎被灭族，鲜血化入水中、带着讯息。
facts.anchor: The sun broke through to reveal the atrocity: my family, my sea folk, had been decimated.

facts.what: 异象里人鱼认出那位嘶喊儿子 Maddox 的人类父亲是 Lennox Gentry——即 River Styx 之子。
facts.anchor: The mystical swimmer knew this was Lennox Gentry. The son of River Styx.

facts.what: Sarah 深夜跑到 Caleb 坟前跪倒痛哭，发现自己仍与亡者相连，并向夜空飞吻致谢。
facts.anchor: My knees buckled at his grave. “Caleb,” I cried, my hands catching me before I crumbled fully.

facts.what: Sarah 撞见 Sebastian 全身黑衣、手拿钥匙溜出家门，便跟到车边以「再拒绝就尖叫」逼他带上自己——Seb 此行是去监视牧师。
facts.anchor: I heard the door crack open and was stunned to see Sebastian fully dressed in black clothing, sneaking out of the house.

facts.what: 夜探牧师住处时，两人看到他正在建围栏社区、成排新房与另一座教堂，借网络与访谈招募新成员（新受害者）；Sarah 觉得此人在对标著名的 Warren Jeffs。
facts.anchor: I got the unsettling sense someone wanted to compete with the famous Warren Jeffs.

facts.what: 异象续篇：男孩 Maddox 被飞行器接走后人鱼举目无亲，River Styx 成为她唯一的朋友并给她取名 Saleeni，此后 River 也不再出现。
facts.anchor: With no family now, I was utterly alone. My only friend became River Styx. He named me Saleeni.

facts.what: Sarah 向围坐的众人揭底：小时候嘴疼时大喊的「Mad G」就是 Johnny 的真名——Maddox Gentry。
facts.anchor: “When our mouths hurt, we yelled it. ‘Mad G’. It stands for Maddox Gentry.”

facts.what: 结尾：Sarah 被通风管里惊慌的人声吵醒（Harmony 在问「他们去哪了」、有人答「去找牧师，我得去把他们弄回来」），她当即穿衣冲下楼、爬进车库面包车后排藏好，要去找这群人。
facts.anchor: I rushed out of my room, down the hall, down the stairs, through the kitchen, and into the garage.
